auth_details: API key via the api_key query parameter; self-serve signup through Geocode Earth.
free_tier_limits: No permanent free tier; two-week free trial with no credit card required.
paid_plans: Lite $100/mo (150k req, ≤10 rps); Basic $200/mo (400k, ≤10 rps); Advanced $500/mo (2M, ≤20 rps); Custom for higher volume.
rate_limits: Plan-dependent: hard per-second limits (Lite/Basic up to 10 rps, Advanced up to 20 rps); trial plans also have hard per-day limits; all plans have soft monthly request allowances.
